verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a GPU cloud platform could plausibly offer scheduled or triggered automations. However, the evidence only shows adjacent pieces. Managed Slurm queues and schedules submitted jobs for cluster resources, cloud-init runs one-off launch-time configuration, and the REST API is a developer building block. None of these is a documented, recurring, autonomous automation feature, and the community MCP server is unofficial and third-party, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
